title: What Causes Privatization? Evidence from Import Competition in China
authors: Qing Hu; Wenjing Li; Chen Lin; Lai Wei
eligible_reason: Continuous-intensity DiD with a common onset: PreTariff_Post = industry pre-WTO tariff level x Post (China's WTO accession, a single date for all firms), plus PreTariff x 2000/2001 leads, time-varying firm controls, firm and province x year FE. Heterogeneity columns add binary-split interactions. No binary staggered treatment.
design_notes: ReplicationCode_Final.do on MainReg.dta: Table 2 reg Tariff on initial private share (validity, cross-section); main tables reghdfe PrivateShare/D_PrivateShare/PrivateShare050/PrivateShare50100/PrivateControl_ASIF PreTariff_Post PreTariff_Year2000 PreTariff_Year2001 $controls, absorb(firm province#year), cluster(cic4); heterogeneity c.PreTariff_Post#i.X_2 and DID_X_2 triple interactions; event-study c.PreTariff_YearYYYY#i.X_2.
data_files_note: ReadMe: Stata analysis datasets shipped (Annual Survey of Industrial Firms-based, merged with tariffs).
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Continuous tariff exposure with a single WTO onset; not staggered.
